replies.text:
Thank you for your feedback. I’d like to clarify that this is an independent personal channel, not an AI company or part of any large-scale operation.

I view AI strictly as a supporting tool—much like an instrument—to help bring my ideas to life. However, the creative core and final direction are entirely human-led. I take copyright and platform policies very seriously and always strive to operate within legal boundaries.

I truly value constructive input from the community. As a creator, I am committed to learning and evolving. I will continue to refine my process to ensure my content is of the highest quality and remains respectful of the artistic landscape. Best regards.
